en.summary: Saudi Arabia opened its fourth Riyadh Global Medical Biotechnology Summit under Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman's patronage. The three-day event focuses on building excellence in medical biotechnology.

stories.title: Trump says ‘open’ to engaging with Iran

en.title: Trump says 'open' to engaging with Iran
en.summary: US President Donald Trump indicated willingness to hold talks with Iran to address Middle East conflict, reversing earlier positions that negotiations were premature. His statement followed postponement of planned discussions between Gulf Arab states and Iran.

en.summary: Saudi Civil Defense lifted all emergency alerts after resolving temporary danger warnings in four southern and southwestern regions including Jazan, Najran, Khamis Mushait, and Abha.
